justification: Two precinct-serving fixes that gate the CoS boundary load: (1) PRECINCT_ID_PATTERNS entries for City of Sydney ('2.13.6'/'5.8'/'6.3.3' section keys) and Ku-ring-gai ('14B_T1'..'14O') so a boundary match no longer falls through to the 'Marrickville' default and scopes the provisions API to the wrong council (the #835 Waverley bug class; Ku-ring-gai polygons are matchable TODAY). (2) precinct_warning no longer suppressed when precinct ids are passed but match zero provisions (locality fallback passes name-shaped ids), and now also fires when an LGA has precinct boundaries with no keyed provisions (Ku-ring-gai Part 14, Marrickville, Leichhardt — content not extracted, previously a silent gap).

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_precinct_boundaries id formats verified live 2026-07-29: Ku-ring-gai '14B_T1'..'14O' (10 rows), CoS ids to be loaded as '2.x[.y]'/'5.x'/'6.x.y'. dcp_precinct_provisions and dcp_precinct_requirements are EMPTY (legacy path dead) — v2_precinct_id on regulatory_provisions is the only serving path. COUNCIL_DOC_PATTERNS already maps city_of_sydney->'Sydney_DCP' and ku_ring_gai->'Ku-ring-gai_DCP'.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a future council introduces dotted ids colliding with the leading-2/5/6 pattern the attribution would mislabel; the pattern is scoped and documented, and Leichhardt C2-prefix ids are pinned by test to still attribute to Leichhardt.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Pattern entries follow the existing Waverley precedent in the same table. Warning block extends the existing cached EXISTS check; adds one Map cache and a council-to-LGA structural map (organisational structure, not regulatory data).

functions.name: getFormerCouncilFromPrecinctId
functions.input: precinct_id string from a dcp_precinct_boundaries match, e.g. '5.2', '14B_T1', 'E1', 'Part 1'
functions.output: council display name used to scope the provisions API; new: '5.2' returns 'City of Sydney', '14B_T1' returns 'Ku-ring-gai'
functions.if_none: empty id returns 'Unknown'; unmatched formats still fall through to the documented 'Marrickville' default (unchanged legacy behaviour, now covered for every live id format)

functions.name: GET for-property precinctWarning block
functions.input: filters.former_council, optional filters.precinct_id (comma-separated ids), optional filters.lga
functions.output: meta.precinct_warning boolean; now true when passed ids match zero provisions, or when the LGA has boundaries but no keyed precinct provisions
functions.if_none: no former_council leaves the warning false exactly as before; missing lga falls back to the COUNCIL_TO_LGA map and skips the boundary branch when unmapped

values.value: COUNCIL_TO_LGA map: ashfield/marrickville/leichhardt -> 'Inner West', waverley -> 'Waverley', ku_ring_gai -> 'Ku-ring-gai', city_of_sydney -> 'Sydney'
values.if_missing: unmapped council slug skips the boundary-existence branch entirely, so the warning simply keeps its provisions-based behaviour

queries.purpose: Do the passed precinct ids match any current provisions for this council (dud-id detection)
queries.where_clause: WHERE source_council = $1 AND v2_precinct_id = ANY($2::text[]) AND is_current = true LIMIT 1

queries.purpose: Does this council have any actionable precinct-layer provisions (pre-existing check, unchanged semantics)
queries.where_clause: WHERE source_council = $1 AND v2_dcp_layer = 'precinct' AND v2_is_actionable = true AND is_current = true LIMIT 1

queries.purpose: Does the LGA have precinct boundary polygons at all (content-not-extracted warning)

break_it.scenario: Locality fallback passes 'Ashfield Town Centre' (name-shaped id matching zero rows); previously warning was suppressed and precinct rows silently absent.
break_it.what_happens: idsMatchProvisions is false so the warning now fires exactly as in the no-id case.
break_it.how: New EXISTS check against the passed ids before suppressing the warning.

break_it.scenario: Ku-ring-gai address inside the Killara Golf Club polygon: geometric match returns '14I', attribution previously defaulted to 'Marrickville' and scoped provisions to Marrickville documents.
break_it.what_happens: Attribution now returns 'Ku-ring-gai'; the warning also fires because no provisions carry '14I' (Part 14 not extracted).
break_it.how: New pattern entry plus the dud-id warning path; pinned by the attribution test.
break_it.repro: getFormerCouncilFromPrecinctId('14I') plus a for-property call with precinct_id=14I

break_it.scenario: Boundary EXISTS result cached forever: after boundaries load for a council, a stale negative cache for its LGA would skip the warning until restart.
break_it.what_happens: Warning missing for that narrow window; the provisions-exist branch already covers CoS (420 actionable precinct rows) so CoS never reaches the boundary branch.
break_it.how: Boundary branch is only reached when the council has NO precinct provisions; loading boundaries for such a council accompanies a deploy/restart in practice, and the cache is per-process.
break_it.repro: Load boundaries for a provisions-less council without restarting the server process.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - after deploy, the CoS boundary load (prepared, gated on this PR) can run; then a Green Square address shows section-5/2 rows and a Ku-ring-gai address inside a Part-14 polygon shows the precinct warning instead of Marrickville-scoped content.
